heading: ***FROST ADVISORIES FOR COOS COUNTY, NH, ESSEX COUNTY, VT, AND THE ADIRONDACKS TONIGHT***Today
text: Mostly sunny south and a mix of clouds and sun from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north. Breezy and cool.Highs in the low to mid 60s, upper 60s to near 70 in the broad valleys west and south.Winds becoming northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph, decreasing later in the day.

heading: Tonight
text: Clear, calm, and chilly. Lows range from above freezing in the northern mountain valleys to upper 40s near Lake Champlain. Patchy frost is possible in the colder valleys of the Adirondacks and Northeast Kingdom. Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Tuesday
text: Areas of valley fog burning off by mid-morning. Sun, mixing with afternoon clouds north. Still cool. Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. Winds light, turning to the south this afternoon near 10 mph.
